\begin{table*}[!t]
\centering
\caption{Per-dataset characteristics of the gradient-boosted teacher, as a
deployable detector. Quality columns (BACC to FAR) are five-seed means $\pm$ SD
over seeds 42--46, with the teacher refit on each seed's split; deployment columns
(footprint to Rel.\ E) are a single seed-42 run on the protocol of Tables~III
and~VI. \emph{Full} is the cost-sensitive teacher used for
encoder construction; \emph{compact} is its validation-selected boosting-round
prefix, chosen without reference to test data. Footprint is the serialized model
in bytes, excluding the preprocessing metadata common to all systems. Energy
prices each tree comparison at the Horowitz accumulate cost of $0.9$\,pJ, a
subtract-and-branch belonging to that cost class; \emph{Rel.\ E} is the ratio to
Tree-to-Spike's SOP-priced arithmetic energy, input layer included, in its
deployed configuration (selected exit where the validation gate admits it, full
window otherwise), so values below unity indicate the ensemble performs less
arithmetic than the spiking student. Footprints price one 16-bit value per leaf
and float32 thresholds; earlier versions priced $K$ values per leaf and overstated
multiclass ensembles by 1.7 to 3.2 times.}
\label{tab:dep:teacher}
